_meta.description: Expanded decision-curve analysis (net benefit) on REAL cached linear-probe probabilities. NB(t)=TP/n - FP/n*(t/(1-t)) on TEST split; isotonic & Platt recalibrators fit on CAL split. integrated_nb = trapezoidal area of NB(t) over the threshold range; integrated_vs_treat_all = integrated_nb(method) - integrated_nb(treat_all).
